column1: # xlang corpus -> CHERI baseline: per-row lifecycle audit + PREDICTIONS.
# Step 0 of plans/cheri-baseline-xlang.md. Predictions are recorded HERE, BEFORE
# any CHERI run; that is the point of this file. Sources: xlang/<row>/asan.txt
# (allocator route, region size, overflow distance) and xlang/<row>/target.md +
# Rows 1-3 excluded: no purecap Rust toolchain. Row 7 excluded: does not exist
# as specified (settled against NVD). 11 measured rows.
# allocroute: how the dangling/overflowed memory dies. This is what decides
#   whether CHERI revocation can see it at all.
#     realloc-vmstack = mrb_realloc moves the VM register stack; old block freed
#     gc-sweep        = mrb_free from the GC sweep/obj_free path
#     direct-free     = explicit mrb_free in gem/runtime code
#     none            = spatial overflow, nothing is freed
# pred_spatial / pred_async / pred_eager use the sqlite taxonomy:
#   SWEEP = BLOCKED-SWEEP (caught only by revocation, not at the contract point)
# cols: row  shim  hostoracle  defectclass  allocroute  geometry  trigger_params  pred_spatial  pred_async  pred_eager  upstream
